correctness.rationale: An overlap newly formed by an append must be a suffix of period p with length 2p+1. Overlap-free sources are cubefree, so their prefix curling-number symbols are precisely 1 or 2 according to a square suffix. Validity is prefix-hereditary. This proves exhaustive BFS, both directly labeled and up to restricted-growth alphabet-renaming symmetry. Replays passed: 1008 canonical terminal rows of full 3-symbol support split 672/336 over exactly P1/P2; independently 6048 labeled words split 4032/2016; no level-85 survivors. The complete TSV was regenerated and byte-compared. Finite exhaustive search, not extrapolation, proves the claim.
